summary: A worker tells {person} which stop drops off the route when the shift ends.
realLife: Seattle cleaning staff told auditors that some shifts ended before they could reach every restroom in their district.
gates: A shift roster and a route with an uncompleted stop.
weights: Travel time between assigned parks raises the chance of a missed stop.
inGame: needs: route order, shift end, stop completion and any relief assignment.

turns.what: The worker asks dispatch to put it first tomorrow.
turns.pulledBy: The last park closes before the crew arrives.
turns.writesBack: Carry the stop to the next route sheet.

turns.what: The supervisor checks the second crew’s entry.
turns.pulledBy: A relief worker takes the last stop.
turns.writesBack: Credit the visit to the crew that made it.
